spans.text: Mayuri is just Mayuri, an ordinary girl you can find anywhere, so kind that she's almost a little dumb.

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: Even so, Mayuri does not loosen her grip on my hands.
units.displayText: Even so, Mayuri does not loosen her grip on my hands.

spans.text: Even so, Mayuri does not loosen her grip on my hands.

units.rawText: Mayuri, when I send this D-Mail, you might end up in a world line where you're all alone.
units.displayText: Mayuri, when I send this D-Mail, you might end up in a world line where you're all alone.

spans.text: Mayuri, when I send this D-Mail, you might end up in a world line where you're all alone.

units.rawText: Would you be okay... even if that happened?
units.displayText: Would you be okay... even if that happened?

spans.text: Would you be okay... even if that happened?

units.rawText: ...Yup
units.displayText: ...Yup

spans.text: ...Yup

units.rawText: Mayushii made up her mind to help Okarin long ago.
units.displayText: Mayushii made up her mind to help Okarin long ago.

spans.text: Mayushii made up her mind to help Okarin long ago.

units.rawText: So Okarin, don't cry...
units.displayText: So Okarin, don't cry...

spans.text: So Okarin, don't cry...

units.rawText: She seems to have thought of something, and then she smiles.
units.displayText: She seems to have thought of something, and then she smiles.

spans.text: She seems to have thought of something, and then she smiles.

units.rawText: No, that's not right. This isn't Okarin standing here...
units.displayText: No, that's not right. This isn't Okarin standing here...

spans.text: No, that's not right. This isn't Okarin standing here...

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: It's the insane mad scientist who always comes to help Mayushii no matter when and where she gets in trouble... Hououin Kyouma!
units.displayText: It's the insane mad scientist who always comes to help Mayushii no matter when and where she gets in trouble... Hououin Kyouma!

spans.text: It's the insane mad scientist who always comes to help Mayushii no matter when and where she gets in trouble... Hououin Kyouma!

units.rawText: ...I can't let her down.
units.displayText: ...I can't let her down.

spans.text: ...I can't let her down.

units.rawText: As I gaze into Mayuri's pure eyes, I make up my mind.
units.displayText: As I gaze into Mayuri's pure eyes, I make up my mind.

spans.text: As I gaze into Mayuri's pure eyes, I make up my mind.

units.rawText: Mayuri, are the preparations for sending the D-Mail complete?
units.displayText: Mayuri, are the preparations for sending the D-Mail complete?

spans.text: Mayuri, are the preparations for sending the D-Mail complete?

units.rawText: Mhm! Mayushii got it all ready beforehand!
units.displayText: Mhm! Mayushii got it all ready beforehand!

spans.text: Mhm! Mayushii got it all ready beforehand!

units.rawText: Kurisu-chan taught Mayushii how to set up everything! Mayushii memorized it all~
units.displayText: Kurisu-chan taught Mayushii how to set up everything! Mayushii memorized it all~

spans.text: Kurisu-chan taught Mayushii how to set up everything! Mayushii memorized it all~

units.rawText: Kurisu's smug face flashes through my mind.
units.displayText: Kurisu's smug face flashes through my mind.

spans.text: Kurisu's smug face flashes through my mind.

units.rawText: ...What an unbelievable assistant I have.
units.displayText: ...What an unbelievable assistant I have.

spans.text: ...What an unbelievable assistant I have.

units.rawText: Muhahaha! Well done, LabMem No. 002, Mayuri Shiina!
units.displayText: Muhahaha! Well done, LabMem No. 002, Mayuri Shiina!

spans.text: Muhahaha! Well done, LabMem No. 002, Mayuri Shiina!

units.rawText: I, Hououin Kyouma, now guarantee you that no matter what world line you end up in, I will find you and come to your side!
units.displayText: I, Hououin Kyouma, now guarantee you that no matter what world line you end up in, I will find you and come to your side!

spans.text: I, Hououin Kyouma, now guarantee you that no matter what world line you end up in, I will find you and come to your side!

units.rawText: Mhm! It's all up to you now, Okarin! For the sake of the Lab and everyone in the Oasis, you have to find Kurisu-chan and then find Mayushii!
units.displayText: Mhm! It's all up to you now, Okarin! For the sake of the Lab and everyone in the Oasis, you have to find Kurisu-chan and then find Mayushii!

units.rawText: But of course! There is nothing I can't do! After all, I am the insane mad scientist, Hououin Kyouma!
